scientific.integrity: The proof reduces the old-to-new block of the lifted Hamiltonian by invertible layer-wise scalings to the unsigned incidence matrix of the preceding Hambly-Kumagai level. Connected bipartiteness then fixes its rank. Exact finite-level replay checks the graph counts and the published level-2, level-3, and level-4 zero multiplicities.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns only the Hambly-Kumagai family with the source's lifted zero-diagonal symmetric Krawtchouk Hamiltonian. It does not cover nonzero diagonal fields, arbitrary radial couplings with zeros, Lang-Plaut graphs, or general diamond networks.

title: An exact half-spectrum zero mode on Hambly-Kumagai perfect-transfer diamonds
